title: kbmon's cleanup panel and a selfcheck leftovers line show each candidate's verdict and the leftover counts
goal: mon_clean, kbmon's cleanup panel, lists each candidate with its class, verdict, reason and bytes from bl_clean.safe_to_remove and a count per class, within the panel timeout; kbmon.py --json --panel cleanup carries the same rows and counts; backlog.py selfcheck adds a leftovers line naming the removable count and bytes, which fails only below tidy's disk-pressure limit

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, env=None, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
WT = os.path.join(C, ".claude", "worktrees")
def wt(name, branch=None, at="HEAD"):
    p = os.path.join(WT, name)
    g("worktree", "add", "-q", *(["-b", branch] if branch else ["--detach"]), p, at, cwd=C)
    return p
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
def own(p, cls, *a, env=None):
    return tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", str(p), "--class", cls, *a, env=env)
def rows(*a):
    return json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", *a).stdout)
def by_path(rs, cls=None):
    return {n(x["path"]): x for x in rs if "path" in x and (cls is None or x.get("class") == cls)}
import json, subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/kbmon.py", "--json", "--panel", "cleanup"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert r.returncode == 0, (r.returncode, r.stderr[-400:])
p = json.loads(r.stdout)["panels"]["cleanup"]
assert p["state"] == "ok", p
rows = p["data"]["rows"]
assert isinstance(rows, list) and all({"class", "verdict", "reason", "bytes"} <= set(x) for x in rows), rows[:3]
assert isinstance(p["data"].get("counts"), dict), p["data"].keys()
